# Paradigm Capital Group

> Paradigm Capital Group is an event management and event production company delivering integrated event solutions across Egypt, the Middle East and the MENA region. The company specializes in event consultancy and management, public relations and VIP management, audiovisual solutions, interpretation and translation, technical support, media production, travel and accommodation, graphic design, branding, printing, catering, and event equipment.

- [Home](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/): Main website and company overview.
- [Our Story](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/our-story/): Company background and experience.
- [Our Services](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/our-services/): Overview of available services.
- [Past Events](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/past-events/): Portfolio of previous events.
- [Corporate Social Responsibility](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/csr/): Social responsibility initiatives.
- [Contact Us](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/contacts/): Contact information.
- [Careers](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/careers/): Career opportunities.

## Company Information

Paradigm Capital Group provides professional event management, event production, technical, logistical, creative and support services for corporate, governmental, diplomatic, international and social events.

The company operates across Egypt, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia.

## Company Statistics

- Events: 2600+
- Clients: 130+
- Years of experience: 14
- Mega Events: 160

## Portfolio & Previous Work and events that paradigm managed

> The following projects represent previous events and event-production work delivered by Paradigm Capital Group. They are portfolio examples demonstrating the company's experience in event management, event production, technical execution, logistics, audiovisual production and stakeholder management.

### Egypt’s Narrative for Economic Development

- [Egypt’s Narrative for Economic Development](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/portfolio/egypts-narrative-for-economic-development/): As part of Egypt’s commitment to sustainable economic growth and strategic development, this initiative gathered leaders to align vision with execution and discuss key national priorities. Paradigm Capital Group proudly executed the full event setup, providing a seamless environment for presentations, panels, and stakeholder engagement. The event convened government officials, international partners, and business leaders to highlight actionable strategies and collaborative solutions that advance Egypt’s economic development on a global scale.

- Date: 2025-09-07
- Location: St Regis, New Capital

### Egypt – Spain Business Forum

- [Egypt – Spain Business Forum](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/portfolio/egypt-spain-business-forum/): The Egypt–Spain Business Forum brought together ministers, business leaders, investors, and key international stakeholders to explore opportunities across trade, investment, innovation, and economic cooperation between Egypt and Spain. Paradigm Capital Group delivered the full event setup and management, creating a seamless environment for official sessions, panel discussions, meetings, and networking.

- Date: 2025-09-18
- Location: St Regis, Cairo

### Egypt–Türkiye Business Forum

- [Egypt–Türkiye Business Forum](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/portfolio/egypt-turkiye-business-forum/): The Egypt–Türkiye Business Forum brought together senior government officials, ministers, business leaders, investors, and key stakeholders from both countries to explore opportunities for trade, investment, and bilateral economic cooperation. Paradigm Capital Group delivered the complete event setup.

- Date: 2026-02-04
- Location: Al Masa Hotel Nasr City

### Egypt – France Business Forum

- [Egypt – France Business Forum](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/portfolio/egypt-france-business-forum/): The Egypt–France Business Forum brought together senior government officials, business leaders, investors, and key stakeholders from Egypt and France to strengthen bilateral economic relations and explore opportunities for trade, investment, and strategic cooperation. ### Egypt-France Business Forum: Economic – Opportunities for Strategic Partnership

- [Egypt-France Business Forum: Economic – Opportunities for Strategic Partnership](https://paradigmcapitalgroup.com/portfolio/egypt-france-business-forum-economic-opportunities-for-strategic-partnership/): Held at Almasa Hotel in the presence of senior Egyptian and French officials, the Egypt–France Business Forum brought together government officials, international business leaders, and key stakeholders to explore economic cooperation.
